subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: Should strict reasoning-tag recovery prefer hidden-reasoning suppression over malformed-answer recovery when an unclosed `<think>` is followed by `<final>` content?
rationale: The current fallback can recover an answer from malformed tags, but the same behavior can expose hidden reasoning in external chat channels; automation should not choose that security/product tradeoff without maintainer intent.

options.title: Recover Only Final Body
options.body: When the original malformed text contains a valid `<final>` body, return only that body and drop pre-final reasoning, with shared sanitizer and WhatsApp/Telegram regressions.

options.title: Fail Closed On Malformed Reasoning
options.body: In strict mode, suppress unclosed reasoning payloads instead of attempting answer recovery, prioritizing privacy at the cost of possible empty replies.

options.title: Keep Current Recovery
options.body: Leave the fallback unchanged and explicitly accept that malformed tagged text can expose reasoning when providers emit unclosed thinking tags.

recommendation.title: Recover Only Final Body
recommendation.body: When the original malformed text contains a valid `<final>` body, return only that body and drop pre-final reasoning, with shared sanitizer and WhatsApp/Telegram regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits in the shared sanitizer policy and assistant-visible delivery boundary where this owner has the strongest sampled feature history.
